The '''junk heap of the ancients''' was a location in the mythology of the [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Squib [[Kwilper]] left his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Skor II]] to search for the junk heap.<ref name="Heroes & Rogues">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>
